### Power Supply - LEADEX III GOLD ARGB PRO / LEADEX III Gold ARGB PRO 850W

##### Products Name : LEADEX III Gold ARGB PRO 850W

 

### Features

LEADEX III Gold ARGB Pro series, which are based on LEADEX III platform, features RGB lighting. The Led RGB light possesses 16 light modes such as, Rainbow mode, Breathing mode, Blink mode, and single color mode etc..which can be controlled manually through the button. The ARGB PSU could also be controlled through the motherboard from ASUS, Gigabyte or MSI with a 5V RGB header. LEADEX III Gold ARGB Pro series PSU provides high efficiency & stable power output and come with a 13cm two-way thermal control intelligent cooling fan to ensure your professional PC system will work under heavy load, also capable of powering your PC system equipped with NVIDIA® SLI™ or ATI CrossFireX™ setup. New LEADEX III ARGB Pro series possess our patents with additional 9-pin universal patent connectors which we called it Super Connector.The Super Connector allows end-users to plug CPU / PCI-E / Peripherals in any of the 9 pin sockets which are more flexible while building the system. The whole cable set is flat ribbon which fits into the current trend.
